assistant.backend_accuracy_hint_ios: Ollama (remote) is the most accurate; {{ollama}} is the recommended model. {{native}} runs on this device and comes next. Apple Intelligence is the least accurate.

assistant.privacy: Runs on-device. Nothing is sent anywhere except your own ZoneMinder server.
assistant.storage_note: Stored in the app's local storage. Removed by Delete.

assistant.temperature_hint: 0 to 1. Leave at 0 unless you have a reason.
assistant.timeout_hint: How long to wait for one answer.
assistant.history_turns_hint: How many earlier questions and answers the model sees.
assistant.advanced_note: Temperature 0 was measured most accurate for reading your camera data. Higher values make the assistant more likely to state a count, a time, or a camera name that is not in the results. Raise the timeout if your server is slow to answer. Remembering more exchanges helps follow-up questions but makes every answer slower.
